newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia c.bank to offer extra bonds on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Russia c.bank to offer extra bonds on Wednesday.

text.p: The Central Bank of Russia will allow banks to bid for selected OFZ interest-bearing bonds after Wednesday's auction, a central bank official said on Tuesday.

The Central Bank usually buys or sells bills and bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry, as well as trading its own portfolio, during secondary market trading on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday. Trading sessions are not usually held on Wednesdays, which are reserved for auctions of new paper.

The session will be held after the auctions, between 1200 and 1230 GMT, to satisfy possible demand after the Finance Ministry repays the series 24010 bonds, central bank capital market operations head Alexei Drugov told Reuters.
The Finance Ministry will offer series 24011, 24012, 24013 and 24014 bonds, he said.
But banks can only bid to buy the bonds at average prices, he said.
For issues 24011, 24012 and 24013 banks can only bid at June 17 average prices, for issue 24014 they can bid at the average price of the Wednesday's auctions, Drugov said.
